ns2:course.label: Professional Development
ns2:course.description: Aimed at professional development in the atmospheric sciences so that students recognize the importance of breath of knowledge, effective oral and written scientific communication, and other skills they will need as professionals. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate student in Atmospheric Sciences or consent of instructor.
